label: KPI Dashboard Commentary Generator
description: Transforms KPI data into management commentary. Explains variances, contextualizes trends, identifies actionable insights, and frames recommendations. For monthly/quarterly reporting.

claudeKnowledge.description: Management reporting best practices, KPI frameworks, business performance analysis

guidedInputs.label: KPI data
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Paste your KPI data. Include: KPI name, actual, target/budget, prior period, and any brief context notes.

Example:
Revenue: €2.4M actual, €2.8M target, €2.1M prior period
Customer satisfaction (NPS): 42 actual, 50 target, 38 prior period
Operating costs: €1.9M actual, €1.8M budget, €1.7M prior period

guidedInputs.label: Additional context
guidedInputs.placeholder: Any market conditions, operational events, seasonal factors, or one-off items that explain performance.
